data.tolerance: Max difference from a cat's weight

data_description.tolerance: Visits further than this from every cat are logged as unidentified (default 0.5 kg). A lighter reading right after a heavier cat's visit is taken as that cat half inside.
data_description.smoothing: How much each visit moves the learned weight (0 = never, 1 = jumps to the reading). It moves towards the median of the latest readings, so one odd reading does not drag it.
data_description.min_weight: Filters out empty-box readings and noise.
data_description.record_unidentified: Off: visits that don't match any cat are ignored completely (no log, count or notification).
